query:
SELECT
                COUNT(DISTINCT batch_id) FILTER (WHERE batch_id IS NOT NULL)
                    AS "batch_count!",
                COALESCE(
                    SUM(quantity) FILTER (WHERE event_type IN ('PICKED_UP', 'RETURNED')),
                    0
                )::bigint AS "qty_sum!"
            FROM t_part_event
            WHERE worker_id = $1
              AND created_at::text LIKE $2
